notes.notes:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with patch 1.3:

 Fixed a bug that caused the interface to disappear after learning a perk. And it did not allow the game to proceed.
Now you can load the save that was causing you this problem and continue your game!
 Fixed a visual bug in the alchemist summary panel and in the tools panel;
 Other minor fixes.


Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified (new user than yesterday).

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with patch 1.2:

 Fixed the bug that in late stages caused the interruption of the activity and led to not being able to proceed in the game;
 The selling activity has been improved. Until now, not satisfying customers could lead to progressively fewer and fewer customers down to zero. This was intentional, but it resulted in the loss of the game. We have entered a minimum customer limit. So that we always have at least one or more loyal customers to sell potions to.
To maintain a high reputation we recommend that you sell potions with the confirmed (green) label, when possible entertain and explain the potion to the customer and sell potions with low toxicity. The toxicity can be deduced during the tasting, or from the color of the potion once the double green label is reached.


Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified.

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
Patch 1.0
Release date and trailer
notes.notes:
With this trailer we are happy to announce that the game will be released on Wednesday May 26, 2021 at 3pm CEST.

The challenge of this trailer was to try to insert at least one second of all aspects of the game, to make it clear how many things can be done inside this game. It wasn't easy as we also wanted to keep it short enough.

We also realized that the game couldn't really be fully explained in such a short time, so we preferred to showcase most of the available activities and content.

We hope you enjoy it and we look forward to seeing you on Wednesday May 26 for the game's release!
